name: @raddus/canvas
description: Raddus Canvas local Anthropic canvas app.

scripts.build: npm run ensure-deps && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.publish:patch: npm ci && npm version patch && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags
scripts.publish:minor: npm ci && npm version minor && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags
scripts.publish:major: npm ci && npm version major && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags
